sa: असंशयं समग्रं मां यथा ज्ञास्यसि तच्छृणु ॥
tr: asaṃśayaṃ samagraṃ māṃ yathā jñāsyasi tacchṛṇu
en: Listen, Partha, how, with your mind attached to me, practising yoga and taking refuge in me, you will know me completely and beyond doubt.
speaker: Krishna said

en: I will teach you this knowledge in full, together with its realisation; knowing it, nothing else here remains to be known.
Among thousands of people, hardly one strives for perfection; and among those who strive and succeed, hardly one knows me as I truly am.

sa: भूमिरापोऽनलो वायुः खं मनो बुद्धिरेव च।
tr: bhūmirāpo'nalo vāyuḥ khaṃ mano buddhireva ca
en: Earth, water, fire, air, space, mind, intellect and ego: this is my nature, divided eightfold.
This is my lower nature. But know my other, higher nature, mighty-armed: the life-principle by which this world is sustained.
Understand that all beings have these two as their source. I am the origin of the whole universe, and its dissolution.

sa: मयि सर्वमिदं प्रोतं सूत्रे मणिगणा इव ॥
tr: mayi sarvamidaṃ protaṃ sūtre maṇigaṇā iva
en: There is nothing whatever higher than me, Dhananjaya. All this is strung on me like pearls on a thread.

sa: प्रणवः सर्ववेदेषु शब्दः खे पौरुषं नृषु ॥
tr: praṇavaḥ sarvavedeṣu śabdaḥ khe pauruṣaṃ nṛṣu
en: I am the taste in water, son of Kunti, the light of the moon and the sun, the syllable Om in all the Vedas, the sound in space and the strength in people.

sa: पुण्यो गन्धः पृथिव्यां च तेजश्चास्मि विभावसौ।
tr: puṇyo gandhaḥ pṛthivyāṃ ca tejaścāsmi vibhāvasau
en: I am the pure fragrance of the earth and the brilliance in fire; I am the life in all beings and the austerity in ascetics.

sa: बीजं मां सर्वभूतानां विद्धि पार्थ सनातनम्।
tr: bījaṃ māṃ sarvabhūtānāṃ viddhi pārtha sanātanam
en: Know me, Partha, as the eternal seed of all beings. I am the intelligence of the intelligent and the splendour of the splendid.
I am the strength of the strong, free from desire and passion; and I am the desire in beings that does not go against dharma, best of the Bharatas.

sa: ये चैव सात्त्विका भावा राजसास्तामसाश्च ये।
मत्त एवेति तान्विद्धि नत्वहं तेषु ते मयि ॥
tr: ye caiva sāttvikā bhāvā rājasāstāmasāśca ye
matta eveti tānviddhi natvahaṃ teṣu te mayi
en: Whatever states of being there are, of goodness, passion or dullness, know that they come from me alone. But I am not in them; they are in me.
Deluded by these three qualities, this whole world does not recognise me, who am beyond them and imperishable.

sa: दैवी ह्येषा गुणमयी मम माया दुरत्यया।
मामेव ये प्रपद्यन्ते मायामेतां तरन्ति ते ॥
tr: daivī hyeṣā guṇamayī mama māyā duratyayā
māmeva ye prapadyante māyāmetāṃ taranti te
en: This divine maya of mine, made of the qualities, is hard to cross. But those who take refuge in me alone cross over it.

sa: न मां दुष्कृतिनो मूढाः प्रपद्यन्ते नराधमाः।
tr: na māṃ duṣkṛtino mūḍhāḥ prapadyante narādhamāḥ
en: Wrongdoers, the deluded and the lowest of people do not take refuge in me; their knowledge stolen by maya, they cling to a demonic nature.
Four kinds of virtuous people worship me, Arjuna: the distressed, the seeker of knowledge, the seeker of wealth, and the wise, best of the Bharatas.

sa: प्रियो हि ज्ञानिनोऽत्यर्थमहं स च मम प्रियः ॥
tr: priyo hi jñānino'tyarthamahaṃ sa ca mama priyaḥ
en: Of these, the wise one, always united and devoted to the One, is the best. I am supremely dear to the wise, and they are dear to me.

sa: उदाराः सर्व एवैते ज्ञानी त्वात्मैव मे मतम्।
आस्थितः स हि युक्तात्मा मामेवानुत्तमां गतिम् ॥
tr: udārāḥ sarva evaite jñānī tvātmaiva me matam
āsthitaḥ sa hi yuktātmā māmevānuttamāṃ gatim
en: All of these are noble, but the wise I regard as my very Self, for, steadfast, they abide in me as the highest goal.
At the end of many births the wise one comes to me, realising, "Vasudeva is everything." Such a great soul is very rare.

sa: तं तं नियममास्थाय प्रकृत्या नियताः स्वया ॥
tr: taṃ taṃ niyamamāsthāya prakṛtyā niyatāḥ svayā
en: Those whose knowledge is carried off by this or that desire turn to other gods, following this or that rule, led by their own nature.

sa: यो यो यां यां तनुं भक्तः श्रद्धयार्चितुमिच्छति।
tr: yo yo yāṃ yāṃ tanuṃ bhaktaḥ śraddhayārcitumicchati
en: Whatever form a devotee wishes to worship with faith, I make that very faith of theirs unwavering.

sa: लभते च ततः कामान्मयैव विहितान् हि तान् ॥
tr: labhate ca tataḥ kāmānmayaiva vihitān hi tān
en: Endowed with that faith, they worship that form and from it receive what they desire; but those gifts are in truth granted by me alone.
Yet the fruit for those of small understanding has an end. Worshippers of the gods go to the gods; my devotees come to me.
The unwise think that I, the unmanifest, have taken on a manifest form, not knowing my higher being, imperishable and supreme.
I am not revealed to all, veiled by my yogamaya. This deluded world does not know me, the unborn and imperishable.

sa: भविष्याणि च भूतानि मां तु वेद न कश्चन ॥
tr: bhaviṣyāṇi ca bhūtāni māṃ tu veda na kaścana
en: I know the beings that have passed, those that are, and those yet to come, Arjuna; but no one knows me.
Through the delusion of the pairs of opposites, born of desire and aversion, all beings fall into confusion at birth, scorcher of foes.
But those of good deeds whose wrongdoing has come to an end, freed from the delusion of opposites, worship me with firm resolve.

sa: ते ब्रह्म तद्विदुः कृत्स्नमध्यात्मं कर्म चाखिलम् ॥
tr: te brahma tadviduḥ kṛtsnamadhyātmaṃ karma cākhilam
en: Those who take refuge in me and strive for freedom from old age and death know Brahman fully, the Self within, and all of action.

sa: साधिभूताधिदैवं मां साधियज्ञं च ये विदुः।
tr: sādhibhūtādhidaivaṃ māṃ sādhiyajñaṃ ca ye viduḥ
en: Those who know me together with the realm of beings, the realm of the gods and the realm of sacrifice, their minds steadfast, know me even at the hour of death.
